primary_source_receipts.locator: Vanguard 2023 lump-sum vs cost-averaging research (1976-2022) via SmartAsset/Wealthfront/Vanguard UK
primary_source_receipts.finding: Lump-sum beat 3-month cost averaging in about 68% of one-year periods (MSCI World); both generally beat holding cash; DCA did better in the worst markets.

primary_source_receipts.locator: S&P Dow Jones Indices SPIVA U.S. Year-End 2025 scorecard
primary_source_receipts.finding: 79% of active large-cap U.S. equity funds underperformed the S&P 500 in 2025 (65% in 2024); 55% mid-cap and 41% small-cap underperformed their benchmarks.
primary_source_receipts.limitations: Scorecard not read directly; long-horizon category counts not confirmed in the summary.
